title: Hermite Polynomial Integration by Parts
statement:
For every natural number $k$ and real polynomial $p$, integration against the standard Gaussian measure satisfies
\[
\int_{\mathbb R} H_{k+1}(x)p(x)\,d\gamma(x)=\int_{\mathbb R}H_k(x)p'(x)\,d\gamma(x),
\]
where $H_m$ denotes the polynomial obtained by mapping the degree-$m$ Hermite polynomial to real coefficients.
